featured_reviews.name: Ramie Kandoth
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had submitted my Scorpio N to Randhawa Motors for a sunroof repair on 8th April 2026. The experience from the very beginning was disappointing. Despite having an appointment, it took the receptionist two days just to share the service station address.
A technician visited a day prior to assess if the issue could be resolved without taking the car in, but that wasn’t possible. After meeting the service manager, I was assured that the repair would be completed within two days, provided everything went smoothly.
However, this timeline was not honored. After multiple follow-ups, I was informed that a part had been ordered, which would take another two days. There was again no update, and upon further follow-up, I was told that the part received was faulty and a replacement had been ordered. Later, another reason was given—that the part did not fit properly and yet another had to be requested.
Throughout this period, I was kept completely in the dark and given inconsistent explanations. Despite clearly expressing the urgency due to work commitments, there was no proactive communication or effort to expedite the process.
When I escalated the issue, I was given the contact of a senior, who appeared unaware of the situation and did not follow through on the promised callback.
A loaner car was only offered on the 10th day, which was far too late. Moreover, I was provided with a 2-door Thar despite informing them that I needed to accommodate elderly passengers. This caused significant inconvenience and even worsened my back discomfort.
What is most concerning is the lack of transparency. It became evident that the part was only ordered after several days, and the delays were masked with inconsistent explanations.
If the repair was expected to take this long, a loaner vehicle should have been offered from the beginning, along with honest communication.
I finally received my car on 22nd April, after nearly two weeks of unnecessary delays and poor handling.
This entire experience has been extremely frustrating and disappointing. The service at Randhawa Motors lacked professionalism, transparency, and customer care and was completely disappointing.
